items.q: I went from highschool to see you do it at Bird Land on Basin Street somewhere. Gerry Mulligan Jerry Logan and, and something.

ctx.x: Oh I really never have played the piano. Just for my own group. Every once in a while I have, but it was not even much you know. It wasn't my forte.
I went from highschool to see you do it at Bird Land on Basin Street somewhere. Gerry Mulligan Jerry Logan and, and something. I remember that
